data.long_description:
Experience elevated waterfront living in this exceptional 2-bedroom residence at Kempinski Residences The Creek, Al Jaddaf. Offering an expansive 2,453 sq ft of thoughtfully designed space, this home combines contemporary elegance with the signature luxury and service of the Kempinski brand—perfect for those seeking comfort, privacy, and sophistication in one of Dubai’s most up-and-coming waterfront communities.

Property Details:

This beautifully appointed apartment features two spacious bedrooms, each with built-in wardrobes and en-suite bathrooms, along with an additional guest bathroom. The open-plan living and dining area is generously sized, enhanced by floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the space with natural light and offer serene views of Dubai Creek.

The modern kitchen is fully fitted with high-quality appliances and sleek cabinetry, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Premium finishes, elegant flooring, and meticulous attention to detail are evident throughout the home, creating a refined and welcoming atmosphere.

2 Bedrooms
3 Bathrooms
2,453 sq ft
Spacious living and dining area
Floor-to-ceiling windows
Fully fitted modern kitchen
Built-in wardrobes
Creek views

Community Amenities:

Residents of Kempinski Residences The Creek enjoy access to a full suite of world-class amenities designed for a luxurious lifestyle, including:

Temperature-controlled swimming pool
State-of-the-art fitness center
24/7 concierge and security services
Spa and wellness facilities
Landscaped gardens and leisure areas
Dedicated parking

Location Highlights:

Ideally situated in Al Jaddaf, this waterfront development offers a perfect balance of tranquility and connectivity. Residents benefit from:

Direct access to Dubai Creek waterfront
Close proximity to Downtown Dubai and Business Bay
Easy access to Dubai International Airport
Nearby healthcare facilities, schools, and retail outlets
Convenient connectivity via major road networks

This property presents a rare opportunity to enjoy spacious luxury living in a prime waterfront location.
